evals.prompt: Rerun EnterpriseRAG-Bench against the current inseam checkout and record a comparable full run.
evals.expected_output: Uses the pinned setup and run commands, refreshes the installed CLI if needed, verifies the completed manifest, and reports the recorded run without committing fixture data.

evals.prompt: Do a one-question smoke check of our Inseam benchmark harness without paying for the upstream LLM judge.
evals.expected_output: Runs the harness with --limit 1 --skip-evaluation, explains that indexing still covers the full corpus, and verifies the retrieval-only run artifacts.

evals.prompt: Compare our two latest EnterpriseRAG-Bench runs and tell me whether retrieval improved.
evals.expected_output: Checks comparability pins, options, dirty state, hardware, and question counts before comparing retrieval and upstream scores, index time, and per-query timings.
